column1: # verification-scaffold guard manifest (#10404) — the machine form of guardrail-audit.md.
# One row per installable guard. Columns:
#   name         guard id the CLI accepts (--guards/--uninstall/--list)
#   verdict      audit verdict (references/guardrail-audit.md) — every v1 row is
#                generic-after-extraction by construction
#   surfaces     hook | ci | hook+ci — which emitted surfaces the guard owns
#   templates    `;`-separated template paths under references/ this row emits
#   default_mode advisory — every v1 guard installs advisory-first (flip MODE= / drop
#                continue-on-error to promote; emitted VERIFICATION.md names the step)
#   deps         external deps the emitted guard needs at the target (NOT satisfied by
#                the emit; checked and named, never silently assumed)
#   source_files `;`-separated repo sources the templates were extracted from (provenance;
#                the near-verbatim pair is byte-pinned by test/manifest.test.sh)
#   emits        `;`-separated target-relative artifact paths this guard emits
#   tier         v1 | v2 — v2 rows are candidates only; the generator refuses to emit them
